
# Title: <Verb> <what changes> (#<issue>)
#   Imperative, sentence case, no period, at most 65 characters
#   (GitHub appends " (#PR)" on squash merge; 72 in total).
#   e.g. "Keep the energy plot paused when a pan reaches the newest sample"
#
# Body, after one blank line, wrapped at 72:
#   - Why: the problem or goal, in a sentence or two.
#   - What: the behaviour that changes; bullets for separate parts.
#   - Tests and docs added or changed.
#   - Physics and headless impact, e.g. "No physics change; headless
#     fixtures and drift thresholds unchanged."
#
# Relations: Closes #N / Part of #N / Related to #N
#   Never start a line with "#": git drops it as a comment.
#
# Attribution: trailers in the last paragraph, one blank line above.
#   AI-assisted:      assisted by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
#   Human co-author:  Co-authored-by: Name <email>
#   Your own work alone gets no trailer.
#   No AI session links or IDs (no "Claude-Session:" or similar).
